mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payments ( subscription_id, billing_cycle_key, attempt_no, payment_type, payment_order_id, idempotency_key, provider, amount, status, requested_at ) VALUES ( #{subscriptionId}, #{billingCycleKey}, #{attemptNo}, #{paymentType}, #{paymentOrderId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{provider}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{requestedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payments WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE payments SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', provider_payment_key = #{providerPaymentKey}, service_period_start = #{servicePeriodStart}, service_period_end = #{servicePeriodEnd}, method_type_snapshot = #{methodType}, card_company_snapshot = #{cardCompany}, card_number_masked_snapshot = #{cardNumberMasked}, approved_at = #{approvedAt}, failure_code = NULL, failure_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'REQUESTED'
UPDATE payments SET status = 'FAILED', failed_at = #{failedAt}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'REQUESTED'
